data.explanation: Direct solar irradiance driving photovoltaic electron generation; primary physical power source.
PV panel surface temperature; higher temperature induces negative thermal voltage drop.
Surrounding air temperature; determines convective panel cooling efficiency.
Difference between module and ambient temperature; proxy for solar heat absorption and wind cooling.
Cyclical sine of time of day; encodes diurnal solar elevation angle smoothly.
Cyclical cosine of time of day; distinguishes morning ramp-up from afternoon ramp-down.
